name: lull-extension
displayName: Lull extension development (tool widgets / wallpaper scenes)

required.node: >=20 (compiles the SDK and runs the CLI)
required.sdk: built SDK in ~/.lull-skill/sdk, produced by `lull-ext sdk build` (or point --sdk/LULL_SDK_DIR at one)
required.shell: write access to the project directory (scaffolds files, copies vendor/, writes zips)

conditional.sdkSource: one of: a local Lull checkout for --from, network + git to clone packages/, or a prebuilt SDK directory
conditional.git: only to clone the SDK or read the local HEAD sha
conditional.npm: only on the first SDK build, to install typescript
conditional.lullApp: Windows desktop app, only to install and verify on a real machine
conditional.bundler: Vite / esbuild, only for TypeScript, React or Vue projects
